<style id="yoast-faq-accordion-inline-css">

/* =============================================
   Yoast FAQ Accordion — Frontend Styles
   ============================================= */

/* Container */
.wp-block-yoast-faq-block {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--color--foreground, #e2e2e2);
    margin-block: 2rem;
}

/* Each FAQ item */
.wp-block-yoast-faq-block .schema-faq-section {
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color--foreground, #e2e2e2);
}

/* Question — clickable header */
.wp-block-yoast-faq-block .schema-faq-question {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 1rem;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 1.125rem 0.5rem;
    margin: 0;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 1.05em;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.4;
    color: inherit;
    background: transparent;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
       -moz-user-select: none;
        -ms-user-select: none;
            user-select: none;
    transition: color 0.2s ease;
}

.wp-block-yoast-faq-block .schema-faq-question:hover,
.wp-block-yoast-faq-block .schema-faq-question:focus-visible {
    color: var(--color--coral);
}

/* +/– indicator circle */
.wp-block-yoast-faq-block .schema-faq-question::after {
    content: "+";
    flex-shrink: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 1.75rem;
    height: 1.75rem;
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1;
    border-radius: 50%;
    color: var(--color--background, #fff);
    background: var(--color--foreground, var(--color--blue));
    transition: transform 0.25s ease, background-color 0.25s ease;
}

/* Expanded indicator */
.wp-block-yoast-faq-block .schema-faq-section.faq-open .schema-faq-question::after {
    content: "\2013"; /* en-dash as minus */
}

/* Answer — collapsed by default */
.wp-block-yoast-faq-block .schema-faq-answer {
    max-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    padding: 0 0.5rem;
    margin-top: 0;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: max-height 0.35s ease, opacity 0.3s ease, padding 0.35s ease;
}

/* Answer — expanded */
.wp-block-yoast-faq-block .schema-faq-section.faq-open .schema-faq-answer {
    max-height: 600px;          /* increase if answers are very long */
    opacity: 1;
    padding: 0 0.5rem 1.25rem;
}

/* =============================================
   Backend — keep everything visible in editor
   ============================================= */
.editor-styles-wrapper .wp-block-yoast-faq-block .schema-faq-answer {
    max-height: none;
    opacity: 1;
    padding: 0 0.5rem 1rem;
}
.editor-styles-wrapper .wp-block-yoast-faq-block .schema-faq-question {
    cursor: text;
}
.editor-styles-wrapper .wp-block-yoast-faq-block .schema-faq-question::after {
    display: none;
}

<script id="yoast-faq-accordion-js-after">
(function () {
    'use strict';

    /**
     * SINGLE_OPEN = true  → accordion (only one answer open at a time)
     * SINGLE_OPEN = false → toggleable (multiple answers can stay open)
     */
    var SINGLE_OPEN = true;

    function initFaqAccordion() {
        var blocks = document.querySelectorAll('.wp-block-yoast-faq-block');
        if (!blocks.length) return;

        blocks.forEach(function (block) {
            var questions = block.querySelectorAll('.schema-faq-question');

            questions.forEach(function (q) {
                // Accessibility
                q.setAttribute('role', 'button');
                q.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
                q.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');

                var section = q.closest('.schema-faq-section');
                var answer  = section ? section.querySelector('.schema-faq-answer') : null;

                if (answer) {
                    var id = answer.id || 'faq-a-' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9);
                    answer.id = id;
                    answer.setAttribute('role', 'region');
                    q.setAttribute('aria-controls', id);
                }

                // Click
                q.addEventListener('click', function () {
                    toggle(block, section);
                });

                // Keyboard: Enter / Space
                q.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        toggle(block, section);
                    }
                });
            });
        });
    }

    function toggle(block, section) {
        if (!section) return;

        var isOpen = section.classList.contains('faq-open');

        // Accordion mode — close siblings first
        if (SINGLE_OPEN && !isOpen) {
            block.querySelectorAll('.schema-faq-section.faq-open').forEach(function (s) {
                s.classList.remove('faq-open');
                var sq = s.querySelector('.schema-faq-question');
                if (sq) sq.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
            });
        }

        // Toggle current
        section.classList.toggle('faq-open');
        var q = section.querySelector('.schema-faq-question');
        if (q) {
            q.setAttribute('aria-expanded',
                section.classList.contains('faq-open') ? 'true' : 'false');
        }
    }

    // Init on DOMContentLoaded or immediately if already loaded
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initFaqAccordion);
    } else {
        initFaqAccordion();
    }
})();

//# sourceURL=yoast-faq-accordion-js-after
</script>
